review_scope: original-resolution early-stop review of the first two mandatory black/neutral-gray individual-renderer pairs
root_findings: M_OffsetWhiteHotCore reads as a flat opaque vector arrow or glued ribbon with hard polygonal edges and no convincing depth.
M_AxialJetLong reads as a long closed capsule or wedge with a vertical cutoff, uniform thickness and sticker-like internal stripe.
Both roles expose the offline flat-vector construction directly in Unity rather than producing a soft volumetric energy form.
The visual failure is already decisive, so generating the remaining nine renderer pairs would not change the proof result.
No composite, timing, prefab completion or lifecycle work is authorized from R10.

r11_binding_requirements.geometry: Build shallow closed or crossed curved volume geometry with a readable three-dimensional cross-section and controlled perspective response. A single flat quad or visibly planar mask is not acceptable.
r11_binding_requirements.core: The white-hot core must be compact, asymmetric and internally graded, with a rounded directional nose and an open or forked trailing bite; no arrow silhouette or hard sticker perimeter.
r11_binding_requirements.axial_jet: The long jet must taper nonlinearly in width and depth, use an unequal broken tail and layered falloff, and avoid a closed capsule, straight stripe or vertical cutoff.
r11_binding_requirements.remaining_roles: Every remaining Muzzle and Impact role must have a distinct functional silhouette, depth layer and falloff profile rather than recoloring the same flat mask.
r11_binding_requirements.proof: Return a small preflight of only the corrected core and axial jet on black and neutral gray first. Frame each complete shape large enough to inspect edge softness, depth and asymmetry.
r11_binding_requirements.stage_limit: Do not implement or capture the other nine roles, composite, timeline, 30-cycle or completed prefab until the two-role preflight receives a new Root decision.
